_meta.title: Indian Heritage - State Cultural Dataset
_meta.note: This is a structured project dataset. For production/publication, verify individual claims against authoritative state tourism, Ministry of Culture, museum, UNESCO or academic sources.
_meta.recommended_ai_rule: Use only supplied data as factual context; distinguish folklore/tradition from verified history; avoid stereotyping communities.

andhra-pradesh.name: Andhra Pradesh

identity.climate: Tropical, with coastal humidity and a drier interior

folklore: Stories connected with Tirupati and regional folk traditions
traditional_life: Agriculture and fishing are important in many regions
Coastal and Rayalaseema communities have distinct food and cultural traditions
processes: Kalamkari: drawing/block printing and natural-dye textile work
Kondapalli toys: lightweight wood carving and painting
andhra-pradesh.source_note: Use official tourism and Ministry of Culture sources for verification of individual entries.

arunachal-pradesh.name: Arunachal Pradesh

identity.climate: Mountainous; varies from subtropical valleys to cold highlands

architecture: Buddhist monastic architecture in western areas
folklore: Oral traditions and origin stories vary by tribe
Legends associated with mountains, rivers and ancestral communities
traditional_life: Many communities maintain strong village and clan traditions
Handloom, farming, horticulture and forest-linked livelihoods are important
processes: Bamboo/cane craft involves splitting, shaping and weaving natural material
Traditional textiles are woven on community looms

assam.name: Assam

identity.climate: Humid subtropical with heavy monsoon rainfall

folklore: Stories of Ahom history and local legends
traditional_life: Tea cultivation is important economically
Riverine communities have distinctive lifestyles and crafts
processes: Muga silk: rearing silkworms, reeling silk and weaving
Bamboo craft: splitting, bending and weaving bamboo
assam.source_note: Official tourism sources identify Assam's arts, crafts and festival traditions.

bihar.name: Bihar

identity.climate: Hot summers, monsoon rainfall and cool winters

folklore: Stories associated with Sita and Mithila traditions
traditional_life: Agriculture and river-based livelihoods are important
Village festivals often combine food, music and community participation
processes: Madhubani painting: line drawing, filling motifs and natural/modern pigments
Sikki craft: drying, splitting and weaving golden grass
bihar.source_note: Madhubani and Khatwa are highlighted among India's traditional crafts.

chhattisgarh.name: Chhattisgarh

identity.climate: Tropical with hot summers and monsoon rainfall

traditional_life: Many tribal communities maintain distinctive art, music and craft traditions
Forest produce and agriculture support many rural livelihoods
processes: Dhokra: wax modelling, clay moulding, metal casting and finishing
Bamboo craft: splitting and weaving bamboo
chhattisgarh.source_note: Bastar Dhokra is listed among India's notable crafts.

goa.name: Goa

identity.climate: Tropical coastal and humid

folklore: Konkan folk legends and village traditions
Stories linked to local temples and churches
traditional_life: Fishing, farming and coastal trade have shaped local life
Village festivals often combine music, food and community participation
processes: Traditional pottery involves clay preparation, shaping, drying and firing
goa.source_note: Goa's official tourism material documents its coastal culture and festivals.

gujarat.name: Gujarat

identity.climate: Mostly dry to semi-arid, with coastal and wetter areas

folklore: Stories of local saints and pastoral communities
Garba traditions connected with devotional storytelling
traditional_life: Kutch and Saurashtra have strong craft and pastoral traditions
Trade and textile production have shaped many communities
processes: Patola: resist dyeing and complex weaving
Rogan: painting with prepared coloured material on fabric
Bandhani: tying fabric points before dyeing
gujarat.source_note: Official tourism highlights Rogan, Ajrakh and other Kutch crafts.

haryana.name: Haryana

identity.climate: Semi-arid to subtropical

traditional_life: Agriculture is central to rural life
Village sports, fairs and community gatherings are important cultural spaces
processes: Traditional embroidery uses counted or decorative stitching on fabric

himachal-pradesh.name: Himachal Pradesh

identity.climate: Mountain climate ranging from temperate valleys to cold highlands

folklore: Local oral histories around villages and valleys
traditional_life: Apple horticulture, farming and pastoralism are important
Village deity traditions influence many community festivals
processes: Kullu shawl: wool preparation, spinning and weaving with traditional patterns
Wood carving: carving local timber into decorative forms
himachal-pradesh.source_note: Official tourism material describes Kullu Dussehra and Himalayan heritage traditions.

jharkhand.name: Jharkhand

identity.climate: Tropical with monsoon rainfall

traditional_life: Agriculture, forests and community traditions are important
Tribal art and music are often linked to seasonal cycles
processes: Dokra: wax casting and metal finishing
Sohrai/Khovar painting: preparing surfaces and applying traditional motifs
jharkhand.source_note: Official tourism highlights tribal heritage, crafts and festivals.

karnataka.name: Karnataka

identity.climate: Varied: coastal tropical, plateau semi-arid and hill climates

traditional_life: Handloom, agriculture and coastal livelihoods vary by region
Temple festivals and village performances remain important cultural spaces
processes: Channapatna toys: turned wood shaping, colouring and finishing
Mysore painting: prepared surface, line work and decorative detailing
karnataka.source_note: Channapatna toys are highlighted by Incredible India.

kerala.name: Kerala

identity.climate: Tropical monsoon

traditional_life: Backwaters, agriculture, fishing and trade shape regional life
Ayurveda and traditional knowledge are prominent cultural themes
processes: Coir: coconut husk processing, fibre extraction, spinning and weaving
Aranmula Kannadi: traditional metal-alloy mirror making
kerala.source_note: Aranmula Kannadi is listed among India's notable crafts.

madhya-pradesh.name: Madhya Pradesh

identity.climate: Tropical with hot summers and monsoon rainfall

traditional_life: Agriculture and forest-linked livelihoods are important
Tribal communities have distinctive art, music and knowledge traditions
processes: Bagh print: washing, carving blocks, dyeing and repeated printing
Gond painting: fine lines, dots and nature-based motifs
madhya-pradesh.source_note: Bagh Prints are highlighted among India's crafts.

maharashtra.name: Maharashtra

identity.climate: Varied from humid coast to drier plateau

traditional_life: Agriculture, coastal fishing and urban trade coexist
Wari traditions connect communities through pilgrimage and music
processes: Warli painting: geometric forms and scenes of community life
Paithani: handloom weaving with traditional motifs
maharashtra.source_note: Warli painting is listed among India's notable crafts.

manipur.name: Manipur

identity.climate: Humid subtropical with hill and valley variation

traditional_life: Handloom and agriculture are important
Loktak Lake and surrounding communities have distinctive livelihoods
processes: Handloom weaving: yarn preparation, loom setup and patterned weaving
manipur.source_note: Official tourism highlights Manipur's heritage and festivals.

meghalaya.name: Meghalaya

identity.climate: Very high rainfall in many areas, with cooler hills

architecture: Traditional Khasi, Jaintia and Garo houses
folklore: Local stories around sacred groves and landscapes
traditional_life: Community institutions and clan traditions are important
Agriculture, weaving and forest knowledge shape many rural communities
processes: Bamboo craft: curing, splitting, shaping and weaving bamboo

mizoram.name: Mizoram

identity.climate: Hilly, humid and monsoonal

folklore: Mizo oral histories and clan stories
Stories associated with migration and village life
traditional_life: Bamboo, weaving and community celebrations are important
Village life historically emphasized collective work and cooperation
processes: Puan weaving: preparing yarn, setting the loom and weaving traditional patterns

nagaland.name: Nagaland

identity.climate: Hilly, humid and monsoonal

folklore: Village origin stories vary among Naga communities
traditional_life: Village councils and community institutions have long been important
Agriculture, weaving and craft traditions are central to many communities
processes: Textile weaving: preparing yarn and creating clan/community-specific patterns

odisha.name: Odisha

identity.climate: Tropical with coastal humidity and monsoon rainfall

folklore: Pattachitra storytelling and regional oral traditions
traditional_life: Temple culture, handloom and craft villages are important
Coastal fishing and agriculture shape many communities
processes: Pattachitra: preparing cloth surface, drawing outlines and filling mineral/organic colours
Pipili applique: cutting coloured fabric and stitching decorative motifs
odisha.source_note: Raghurajpur is documented for Pattachitra, palm-leaf art and Gotipua traditions.

punjab.name: Punjab

identity.climate: Semi-arid to subtropical with hot summers

food: Sarson da saag and makki di roti
traditional_life: Agriculture has strongly shaped Punjabi culture
Community meals, music and fairs are important social traditions
processes: Phulkari: decorative embroidery on fabric using coloured threads
punjab.source_note: Phulkari is highlighted among India's notable crafts.

rajasthan.name: Rajasthan

identity.climate: Mostly hot and dry, with desert regions and varied Aravalli landscapes

traditional_life: Water conservation and clothing practices reflect adaptation to dry environments
Craft communities maintain specialized textile, leather, wood and metal traditions
processes: Bandhani: tying small fabric sections before dyeing
Kathputli: carving/assembling puppets and decorating them for performance
Block printing: carved blocks, dye application and repeated printing
rajasthan.source_note: Kathputlis are listed among India's notable crafts.

sikkim.name: Sikkim

identity.climate: Mountainous, ranging from subtropical valleys to alpine zones

folklore: Legends surrounding mountains and sacred landscapes
traditional_life: Monasteries and mountain agriculture influence cultural life
Lepcha, Bhutia and Nepali traditions contribute to the state's diversity
processes: Carpet weaving: yarn preparation and patterned loom weaving

tamil-nadu.name: Tamil Nadu

identity.climate: Tropical, with coastal humidity and varied rainfall

folklore: Tamil Sangam and devotional literary traditions
traditional_life: Temple arts, agriculture and handloom traditions remain culturally important
Classical music and dance have strong institutional and community traditions
processes: Tanjore painting: prepared board, relief work, gold foil and painting
Bronze casting: traditional lost-wax process
tamil-nadu.source_note: Official tourism sources cover Tamil Nadu's heritage, arts and temple traditions.

telangana.name: Telangana

identity.climate: Hot semi-arid to tropical

traditional_life: Handloom and agriculture are important
Hyderabad combines Deccan, Persianate, Telugu and Urdu cultural influences
processes: Ikat: resist dyeing yarn before weaving
Cheriyal painting: preparing scroll surfaces and painting stylized narrative scenes
telangana.source_note: Karimnagar silver filigree is listed among India's notable crafts.

tripura.name: Tripura

identity.climate: Humid subtropical with monsoon rainfall

folklore: Unakoti legends and local sacred stories
traditional_life: Bamboo, weaving and agriculture are important
Tribal and Bengali cultural traditions coexist across the state
processes: Bamboo craft: cutting, curing, splitting and weaving
Handloom weaving of traditional Risa and Rignai patterns

uttar-pradesh.name: Uttar Pradesh

identity.climate: Subtropical with hot summers and monsoon rainfall

traditional_life: Large regional variation exists between Awadh, Braj, Purvanchal, Bundelkhand and other areas
Crafts, pilgrimage and agriculture are major cultural themes
processes: Chikankari: hand embroidery using fine stitches
Zardozi: metallic-thread embroidery on fabric
uttar-pradesh.source_note: Zardozi is listed among India's notable crafts.

uttarakhand.name: Uttarakhand

identity.climate: Mountainous, ranging from subtropical foothills to alpine zones

traditional_life: Terraced agriculture and pastoralism are important
Village deity traditions and seasonal festivals remain culturally significant
processes: Aipan: applying stylized geometric and ritual motifs to prepared surfaces
Ringaal: splitting and weaving mountain bamboo

west-bengal.name: West Bengal

identity.climate: Humid tropical/subtropical, varying from Himalayas to delta and coast

traditional_life: Riverine, deltaic, urban and Himalayan regions have distinct cultures
Literature, music, theatre and crafts are prominent
processes: Kantha: layered cloth stitched with decorative and narrative patterns
Terracotta: clay shaping, drying and firing
west-bengal.source_note: Santipore textiles and Bengal crafts are highlighted in official tourism material.
